svg.title: northern development 2023 horizontal reversed
svg.desc: Original source vector extraction. Source: https://www.northerndevelopment.bc.ca/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/NDIT_2023-AR-_Web.pdf; PDF page 1; crop in page points [72, 70, 240, 118]. Native PDF paths and shadings converted with Poppler pdftocairo. Gradient shadings retained as SVG linearGradient elements; no bitmap approximation.
